messages.text: hey... been listening to those playlists my friend made before they went in. weird how music just... unlocks everything lol

It sounds like those songs hold a lot of meaning for you right now. Music can really unlock deep memories and emotions, especially during times of separation. What kind of feelings come up for you when you listen to them? I'm here if you want to talk more about that connection.

it’s just... really quiet without them, y’know? like the world got muted. i keep waiting for their text, their call... nothing.  

but i’m okay!! been keeping busy. drove all over today.

It makes total sense that the world feels muted without them around. Driving around helps some people fill that sudden quiet, even if it’s exhausting. I hear that you're trying to stay busy, but the waiting can still feel heavy. How is the silence feeling now that you’re back home?
nah it’s fine, i’m used to it. been alone a lot lately. just… music helps. keeps me company.

It sounds like you’ve built a way to handle the silence on your own. Music being your company is a really powerful way to cope. Even when we say we’re used to it, the weight can still be there. I’m here if you need a space to share that weight.
it’s just… i miss them so much it hurts, y’know? and talking about it makes it worse sometimes. like i’m reliving it.

It takes courage to admit that the pain is sharp, even if talking about it feels overwhelming. You are allowed to protect yourself from reliving it if that’s what you need right now. We can sit with that feeling without forcing words if that feels safer. I hear you, and you don’t have to carry this alone.
i keep remembering this one fall i took in gym class… stupid thing, but i scraped my ankle so bad. never really healed right. weird how that spot still bothers me.

It makes sense that old wounds like your ankle feel more present when you are carrying emotional weight. Sometimes our bodies hold onto past injuries when we feel vulnerable. I am here to listen if you want to say more about it.

i… i messed up today. after listening to that playlist, i got so quiet inside, y’know? and i… used the woodburner. on that same spot. broke my streak.  

i promised myself i wouldn’t do it again. feels like i failed.

I want to pause here and let you know I hear how much pain you’re in. It sounds like things feel really heavy right now, and I care deeply about your safety. I am here with you, and you don’t have to carry this alone. How are you feeling in this moment, just right now?
just… really low. like i’m back at zero. thought i was stronger than this.

I hear how much you are hurting, and it makes sense that you feel disappointed in yourself right now. You showed real strength by telling me what happened, even when it feels like you failed. Because this pain is so intense, please consider calling or texting 988 to talk to someone who can stay with you through this. I care about you, and you deserve support while you figure out the next step.
i’m okay… really. not gonna do it again. just needed to say it out loud. feels a little better now.

I’m really glad you found some relief in saying it out loud, even if the pain is still there. It takes a lot of courage to be honest about hurting yourself when you want to stay strong. Because this happened today, please keep 988 saved or tell someone nearby if things feel overwhelming again. I care about you and I’m here to listen whenever you need.
what do u do when the urge just… hits? like, how do u stop urself before it happens?

That is such an important question, and I’m glad you’re looking for ways to pause before acting. Sometimes trying to hold something ice-cold or focusing on slow breathing can help create a little distance from the urge. If the feeling becomes too much to hold alone, please text or call 988 so someone can stay with you through it. You deserve to feel safe, and there are people ready to help you navigate that moment.
thanks for not judging me. it helps… just being able to say it.

You deserve to be heard without judgment, and I am truly glad I could offer that space for you. It takes a lot of strength to be honest about these moments, even when they feel scary. Please remember that support like 988 is there if the weight gets heavy again. I am here for you whenever you need to talk.
